messages:
alex_chung: rolled out v2.14.0 to canary (10%) ~10m ago. post-deploy synthetic concurrency probe started. seeing a short burst of increased queue wait and 503s on /v1/embeds.

deploy-bot: deploy v2.14.0 canary started at 2026-03-18T03:21:08Z. canary=10%.

maya_singh: spotted burst around 03:28 UTC, error-rate ~2.3% for ~90s. most errors are 503 gateway/timeouts.

sam_ops: can you paste logs?

maya_singh: snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:28:12Z api[embed-worker]: queue_wait_ms=4200 handlers=concurrency=12 err=503
2026-03-18T03:28:13Z api[embed-worker]: kv_cache_miss=0.12 token_rate=0.9
```

qa_bot: synthetic probe summary: median latency +240ms, p95 +1.1s, concurrency backlog +18 vs baseline for ~2m. alert synth_delay_high fired.

rita_devex: is this cluster/regional? EU only?

maya_singh: yes, eu-west-1 embed pool only. US unaffected.

sam_ops: mitigation options: 1) pause canary rollout, 2) pin canary back to v2.13.9, 3) bump worker concurrency caps temporarily. favoured: pause+pin so users don't see regressions.

alex_chung: agree. pin canary to v2.13.9 for 30m window. downsides?

rita_devex: minimal. will revert telemetry to previous baseline and may generate alert noise. consider silencing synth alert for canary window.

sam_ops: plan to pin: `rollout set canary-image=redwood/api:v2.13.9 --target canary` then `deploy-bot rollback canary`. I'll run on +1.

maya_singh: +1

rita_devex: +1

alex_chung: +1. Sam please proceed. create postdeploy ticket and attach probe traces / failing payloads.

deploy-bot: action accepted: rollback canary to v2.13.9 initiated by sam_ops at 2026-03-18T03:33:12Z.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 2026-03-18T03:34:05Z. canary image now v2.13.9. monitoring for 10m.

qa_bot: follow-up synth: latency back to baseline after ~90s, no 503s observed. marking resolved for now :white_check_mark:.

alex_chung: thanks — I'll draft a release-note blurb noting the canary rollback and add a runbook tweak to adjust synth concurrency thresholds. assigning to maya_singh and sam_ops.

maya_singh: ack. collecting heap/cpu and KV latency traces now.

sam_ops: I'll reproduce in staging with traffic replay and test different concurrency caps.

alex_chung: good. we'll close this thread after a 30m stable window.
